func quoteSignerWorkflowMeta(s string) string {
	const special = `\.+*?()|[]{}^$`
	out := make([]byte, 0, len(s)*2)
	for i := 0; i < len(s); i++ {
		c := s[i]
		for j := 0; j < len(special); j++ {
			if special[j] == c {
				out = append(out, '\\')
				break
			}
		}
		out = append(out, c)
	}
	return string(out)
}

}
